As of October 14, 2025, PCs running Windows 10 will still function, but Microsoft will no longer provide the following: Technical supportFeature updatesFree security updates or fixes While your Windows PC will continue to function, it will be at greater risk for viruses and malware when Windows 10 reaches end of support. We recommend you transition to a version of Windows that is still supported. If your existing device cannot run Windows 11 Pro, a new business PC that can run Windows 11 Pro makes for an easy transition and great experience. Will my Windows 10 PC stop working? No. Your PC will continue to work, but support for Windows 10 Pro is discontinued. After October 14, 2025, your Windows 10 PC will no longer receive free security updates and Microsoft will no longer provide Windows 10 Pro technical support. Is Microsoft Surface a tablet or laptop? Microsoft Surface lineup offers versatile devices that can function as both tablets and laptops. Models like Surface Pro and Surface Go are 2-in-1 devices with detachable keyboards, allowing them to switch between tablet and laptop modes. Meanwhile, the Surface Laptop series is designed as traditional laptops with touchscreens. Does Microsoft Surface come with Office? Microsoft Surface devices for business do not come with Office pre-installed. However, you can purchase Microsoft 365 separately, which includes Office apps like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Microsoft 365 offers various plans tailored to small businesses, providing additional features such as cloud storage and collaboration tools. What is the best Surface Pro for business? The best Surface Pro for businesses would be the Surface Pro for Business 11th Edition, Copilot+ PC. This AI-powered 2-in-1 tablet and laptop runs Windows 11 Pro and has up to 1 TB of storage. It's lightweight, versatile, and has a powerful Snapdragon X Plus or Snapdragon X Elite Processor. What are the differences between Surface Pro and Surface Laptop for Business? The main differences between Surface Pro and Surface Laptop for Business are their form factors and use cases. Surface Pro is a 2-in-1 device, offering tablet portability with a detachable keyboard, making it ideal for flexible, mobile work. Surface Laptop, on the other hand, is a traditional laptop with a more robust build, offering larger screens and longer battery life for those needing consistent laptop power. Both run Windows 11 Pro. What warranty options are available for Surface for Business devices? Surface for Business devices come with a standard hardware warranty, which includes one year of coverage for defects and malfunctions. You can also opt for extended warranty options like Microsoft Extended Hardware Service, offering up to three years of protection, and Microsoft Complete for Business, which covers accidental damage for the same duration, ensuring peace of mind for your small business What is the best tablet or 2-in-1 laptop for a business? The Surface Pro for Business, Copilot+ PC is a great choice. This 2-in-1 tablet features AI tools, Windows 11, up to 1 TB storage, and Snapdragon X Plus or X Elite processors. Another great option is the Surface Pro 10 for Business. Its durable, lightweight design is perfect for remote work, and its compatibility with essential business software like QuickBooks enhances productivity. Is Microsoft Surface Laptop good for businesses? Yes, the Microsoft Surface Laptop lineup is great for businesses, especially small ones. They offer a sleek design, long battery life, and powerful performance for everyday business tasks. With enterprise-grade security, built-in Windows 11 Pro, and compatibility with business software, any Surface Laptop provides a reliable and secure environment for managing operations, whether you're in the office or on the go. What is the difference between Surface Pro or Laptop for Business vs Consumer? The primary difference between Surface Pro or Laptop for Business and Consumer models is in their features and focus. Business models offer enhanced security (like Windows 11 Pro), greater processing power, more storage options, and enterprise-grade features such as remote management and productivity tools. They are built for durability and performance in professional environments. Consumer models, in contrast, are designed for everyday use, with a focus on affordability and entertainment features. How can using a Surface for Business tablet benefit a small business? Using a Surface for Business tablet can significantly benefit a small business by enhancing productivity and flexibility.
